answer: Each candidate posts a 250 POA bond and solves an admission puzzle whose difficulty doubles per identity minted from its hardware cluster. The first registration takes a second; the sixty-fourth takes a week. Three established peers with no shared sponsor sign the record, and a sybil finding burns the bond and the sponsor's stake. Forging 2,000 identities from one cluster costs $14,000 in bonds and 90 days of machines. The honest signal is an uneven pulse of arrivals, and the desk works like a velvet rope that rises when the same hand pushes it aside.
